snippet.title: SOMBRAS: negative frames - Demo Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Photography student Shiomi Alterio is pulled into a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town, full of hungry shadows and girls who look just like her. In this first-person light-horror adventure from Maboroshi Artworks, she has to take pictures to find her way home, and it launches December 3 on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2 and PC.
